Machine Learning Engineer (NLP)
Orbitaly
Remote · $4500–6000

Orbitaly builds a customer support assistant used by online stores in 30 countries.

Responsibilities
- Fine-tune and evaluate language models for intent detection
- Serve models with FastAPI and Triton
- Track experiments in MLflow

Requirements
- 3+ years in ML engineering
- Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face
- Experience with Docker and SageMaker
- Upper-Intermediate English

We offer
- Fully remote work
- GPU budget for experiments
